ngaap.guidance: 2024 guidance (24-Oct-2024): Revenue $21.1B - $21.3B (prior $21.0B - $21.3B); adjusted segment operating margin ~15.5% (prior 15.2% - 15.4%); Non-GAAP diluted EPS $12.95 - $13.15 (prior $12.85 - $13.15); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.2B. Segments: SAS revenue ~$7,000M, margin low 12%; IMS revenue $6,600 - $6,700M (prior $6,500 - $6,700M), margin mid - high 11% (prior mid 11%); CS revenue ~$5,400M (prior $5,300 - $5,400M), margin mid - high 24% (prior mid 24%); AR revenue $2,400 - $2,500M, margin mid 12% (prior high 11%). Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$30M; non-service FAS pension income ~$310M; net interest expense ~$660M; effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.0% - 13.5%; average diluted shares flat; capital expenditures ~2% of sales. LHX NeXt: 2024 cost savings target raised from $400M to at least $600M; overall $1B target expected a year early; 2026 segment operating margin of at least 16%.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted segment operating income/margin = operating income excluding the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, unallocated corporate department expense and the significant / non-recurring items (amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and inventory step-up, merger / acquisition / divestiture-related expenses, divestiture losses and impairments, LHX NeXt implementation costs); in 2024 it equals the sum of segment operating income except where a segment-level impairment is added back (Q4-24 / FY24: $24M at CS). Non-GAAP EPS (2024 basis) = diluted EPS + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (and inventory step-up) + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs, less income taxes on the adjustments (and NCI portion). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income = (income taxes + tax on the same items) / (income before income taxes + the items). Adjusted free cash flow = net cash from operating activities - additions to PP&E (net of proceeds from sale of PP&E where shown) + cash used for merger, acquisition and severance (severance included from 2024; prior-year comparatives reclassified). Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures and first-year acquisition revenue (Aerojet Rocketdyne until 28-Jul-2024). Pension adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS is first published in the Q3-24 release (Table 9): non-GAAP diluted EPS less after-tax FAS/CAS operating adjustment ($0.03) and non-service FAS pension income ($0.37). Quarter free cash flow bridge recorded; year to date: 1,430 / (290) / 1,140 / 146 / 1,286.
